TIME IS OF THE ESSENCE!'; Axios/Ravid: Trump convenes Situation Room Tue May 19 to review military options; Netanyahu cabinet 'we are prepared for any scenario'; AP: Israel 'coordinating with US about possible resumption'; IRGC threatens to 'deactivate' US Gulf bases; Day 9 zero-kinetic streak on Iran (40 days since Apr 7) — LONGEST OF WAR, exceeds Kosovo 78-day Allied Force record; Israeli strikes kill ≥5 in 5 southern Lebanon villages (Tayr Felsay, Tayr Debba, Az-Zrariyah, Jebchit, Jouaiya); Lebanon CF extended +45 days (May 15); Bloomberg Hormuz tracker: ZERO Sun-morning transits; Jones Act waiver expires today; daily-burn RECALIBRATED to $95M/day (CSIS standby) post-Ford CSG return; AAA gas $4.513 (-0.4¢ d/d); markets closed Sun, futures gap-down expected on CME 6 PM ET reopen

Rubio cited 'some good signs' but said Washington retains 'other options.' House GOP PULLED the Iran War Powers resolution that appeared to have the votes to pass — Rep.
